notes.title: First Test Sessions Are Coming
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022744/ef95891a99ea31ff24a9be7fac897c9bf6614d8b.png"][/img][b]🧪 First Test Sessions Are Coming – Enter the Shadows[/b][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]first playtest phase[/b] for [i]Forsaken Shadows[/i] is approaching.[/p][p]In this early build, selected players will step into the haunting world of David – a man trapped between reality and something far more disturbing. Experience the opening hours of the game, uncover lost memories, and come face-to-face with the secrets behind [b]Project Umbra[/b].[/p][p]These tests are designed to gather your feedback and help us shape the core of [i]Forsaken Shadows[/i] before its full release.[/p][p]🧠 Psychological horror. 🕯️ Atmospheric tension. 🔍 A narrative that dares you to look deeper.[/p][p][b]Are you ready to confront your fears?[/b][/p][p]🗓 Details on how to join the playtest will be revealed soon. Stay close. The shadows are moving.[/p][p]#ForsakenShadows #Playtest #IndieHorror #Subject34 #ProjectUmbra #PsychologicalHorror[/p]
